title: SIEM Alert #SIEM-77412: Email Sign-in Anomaly

fields.rule: Cloud email suite - authentication anomaly (distributed failed sign-ins)
fields.ruleDescription: Fires when failed sign-ins against the cloud email tenant exceed 1,000 in 30 minutes across more than 100 mailboxes from more than 20 source IPs. No successful sign-in or MFA challenge has been tied to this activity.

dest.host: Cloud email suite - tenant sign-in endpoint

tactics: T1589.002 Gather Victim Identity Information: Email Addresses

details.value: 50126 Invalid username or password (98.7%); 50034 User does not exist (1.3%)
No shared IPs, accounts or indicators with ICM-MES-01, ICM-MES-02, ICM-FS-03 or ICM-FS-04
Same afternoon as the ransomware, has to be them coming for email next? Want me to pull two people off the MES scoping?

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. It shows a routine, low-and-slow password spray: no successful sign-ins, no MFA prompts, generic shared-mailbox targets and similar closed alerts from earlier weeks. Watch whether the CISO keeps one analyst on it to confirm there are no successes, logs it and keeps the scoping team on Beloit and the ERP integration, rather than moving people off the MES work or calling it a second front.
